messages:
lee: quick heads-up — I need ephemeral prod access (~30m) to pull a small log sample for a redaction QA before tomorrow's client demo. can't repro locally, errors only show up in prod traces.

maria: what's the exact scope & justification? we need ticket + timeframe for records.

lee: ticket INF-4821, purpose: confirm our regex redactor removes email/ssn in v2 pipeline. will run `psql -h prod-db -U readonly -c "SELECT id, payload FROM logs WHERE service='ingest' AND created_at > now()-interval '2 hours' LIMIT 200"` and then run local redact script. no writes.

sam: please don't paste raw outputs here. ensure you redaction script runs locally and only store sanitized samples. approve if security reviews the ticket and we get a JIT token. pinging @alex for time-bounded role.

alex: +1 for 30m window. I'll create a scoped role with no write and limited tables. start at 09:30 UTC, end 10:00 UTC. confirm you only need SELECT on logs.read_only_view.

security-bot: JIT access request received for lee on INF-4821. Audit record created: https://redwood.internal/audit/req/5892. Please attach confirmation when done.

maria: add a short note in the ticket documenting the regex you used and the sample hashes so we can trace. also include reviewer sign-off.

lee: understood. I'll only download sanitized rows; running redact locally and will paste only hashed ids. command I'll run (sanitizer run):
```bash
cat sample.json | ./tools/redact --pattern email --pattern ssn --out sanitized.json
```

sam: role created: `prod-logs-readonly-ephemeral/lee/5892` granted 09:30–10:00 UTC. MFA and session recording enforced.

lee: grabbing sample now. will post a brief confirmation when complete. thx all :pray:

alex: noted. keep monitoring the session in case rollback needed.

lee: done — pulled 120 rows, ran redact, uploaded sanitized.json to INF-4821 (private attachment). recorded session link: https://redwood.internal/sessions/77321. no PII found in sanitized output. closing the JIT window. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks — documented in ticket and added QA sign-off. closing loop. :thumbsup:

security-bot: JIT access closed for lee; audit updated.
